What I want to build next: The Living Arcade- A Game You Can Play With Your Whole Body
If I could build my first project with Builders.mu, I would create The Living Arcade, an interactive, large-scale gaming installation that turns a simple game into a shared physical experience.

The idea is to build a giant arcade wall where people can play using oversized physical buttons, joysticks, and motion-based interactions. A large display would show the game, while LEDs, sound effects, and physical feedback would make every move feel alive. Instead of one person playing alone, the system could support challenges between individuals or teams, turning the game into something people gather around, compete in, and remember.

I would approach it by first building a small working prototype using Arduino, physical controls, and a display. Once the core interaction works reliably, I would expand it into a larger structure, integrate lighting and sound, and test it with real users. I would work closely with the creative team to refine the experience while keeping the electronics modular, safe, and easy to maintain.

My goal would not simply be to build another game, but to create a physical experience that makes people stop, get curious, participate, and have fun together. My previous Arduino gaming projects gave me a starting point, and I would use this opportunity to push beyond what I have built before.
